semantics.identificationNotPermission: Matching a date window identifies the stage for cap accounting; it does not establish legal exploration tonight
semantics.originalPlanningEnabled: The old tower_stages planningEnabled flag controls original limited action scope, not independent stage-identification eligibility
semantics.stableCaps: Keep caps for every stable stage ID even if not active/schedulable or active stage unknown
semantics.unknownUsedVisits: Unknown counts never become0. New current checkpoint supplies known counts or explicit unknowns
semantics.visitUnit: One optional exploration night/session; returning to lobby is not another visit
semantics.mandatoryStage11: Mandatory final-operation slot not ordinary optional trip; keep record distinct
semantics.dungeonResults: Observed net cash OR absolute balance and highest floor only; no automatic rescues/boss victories from floor unless separately evidenced
semantics.precedence: This operational accounting contract supersedes raw nominal date claims in tower_stages.json. That source catalogue remains unchanged for provenance.
semantics.mandatoryTutorial: 06-13 scripted tutorial is excluded from optional-night caps. No implied zero used visits.
semantics.historicalMigration: Do not silently reassign recorded visits across corrected boundaries. Reconcile block and expedition-kind evidence; preserve all caps/counts.
